title: Add eval traceback annotator and rollback scorer for fine-grained regression rollforward
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR adds a lightweight eval "traceback annotator" that captures per-sample failure traces and a rollback scoring heuristic to guide automatic rollforward/rollback decisions in CI. Motivation: noisy regression gates have been failing with broad signals; this change surfaces minimal failure fingerprints and computes a ranked rollback score so the pipeline can pick the smallest necessary patch to revert. The implementation includes a snapshot-backed failure ledger (for incremental replays), a trace summarizer that extracts biased tokens/slots influencing metric drops, and a simple scorer that weights the ledger entries by cohort impact and recency. Backwards-compatible CI hook is added so existing smoke/eval jobs can opt-in with a single flag. See commits summary for more detail.
commits_summary: Five commits: 1) add failure ledger data model and write/read helpers; 2) implement traceback annotator and minimal token saliency extractor; 3) add rollback scorer and scoring unit tests; 4) integrate snapshot-backed replay hook into eval runner; 5) docs and CI integration configuration with feature flag.
small_snippet_diffs: eval/harness/annotators/traceback.py: added TracebackAnnotator.extract() which returns a compact fingerprint string and token_saliency list; eval/harness/scores/rollback_scorer.py: new compute_score(ledger_entries, cohort_map) with tunable weights via ENV VAR 'ROLLBACK_WEIGHT_V1'; ci_snapshot_hook.py: registers --enable-traceback-rollforward flag in runner.
